create_phimoe_config: create a PhiMoEConfig instance with custom vocab size, hidden size, and expert parameters
build_phimoe_model: build a PhiMoEModel with vllm config, embedding tokens, and decoder layers
run_phimoe_forward: run a PhiMoEForCausalLM forward pass with input ids, positions, and optional intermediate tensors
load_phimoe_weights: load weights into a PhiMoEForCausalLM model using AutoWeightsLoader and expert mapping
test_sparsemixer_routing: test the sparsemixer routing function that selects top-2 experts with sparsity masking
